title.narrative: Reducing economic vulnerability for increased stability through industrial skills development and business linkages

description.narrative: The online SSS is not in line with donor requirements. Therefore the donor template for JSB 2015 funding has been completed instead. The proposed project will develop the technical and professional skills of vulnerable youth and women at existing vocational training centres. The project concept builds upon the country's main priorities and the emerging development regional and national challenges. It is fully aligned with the donor's priorities for the region and the leading role that Morocco could play to ensure regional stability. It also builds upon UNIDO's experience, expertise and presence in the selected region. The project echoes the growing importance given in the country to technical and vocational training as a catalyst for employment gen eration and sustainable socioeconomic development. The proposal helps Morocco to transit towards #free, democratic and tolerant society# and therefore aligns with the priorities of Deauville Partnership with Arab Countries in Transition.
